67: The structure `ContDiffBump` contains the data required to construct the function:
68: real numbers `rIn`, `rOut`, and proofs of `0 < rIn < rOut`. The function itself is available through
69: `CoeFun` when the space is nice enough, i.e., satisfies the `HasContDiffBump` typeclass. -/
70: structure ContDiffBump (c : E) where
71:   /-- real numbers `0 < rIn < rOut` -/
72:   (rIn rOut : ℝ)
73:   rIn_pos : 0 < rIn
74:   rIn_lt_rOut : rIn < rOut
75: 
76: /-- The base function from which one will construct a family of bump functions. One could
77: add more properties if they are useful and satisfied in the examples of inner product spaces
78: and finite-dimensional vector spaces, notably derivative norm control in terms of `R - 1`.
79: 
80: TODO: do we ever need `f x = 1 ↔ ‖x‖ ≤ 1`? -/
81: structure ContDiffBumpBase (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] where
82:   /-- The function underlying this family of bump functions -/
83:   toFun : ℝ → E → ℝ
84:   mem_Icc : ∀ (R : ℝ) (x : E), toFun R x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
85:   symmetric : ∀ (R : ℝ) (x : E), toFun R (-x) = toFun R x
86:   smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (uncurry toFun) (Ioi (1 : ℝ) ×ˢ (univ : Set E))
87:   eq_one : ∀ R : ℝ, 1 < R → ∀ x : E, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → toFun R x = 1
88:   support : ∀ R : ℝ, 1 < R → Function.support (toFun R) = Metric.ball (0 : E) R
89: 
90: /-- A class registering that a real vector space admits bump functions. This will be instantiated
91: first for inner product spaces, and then for finite-dimensional normed spaces.
92: We use a specific class instead of `Nonempty (ContDiffBumpBase E)` for performance reasons. -/
93: class HasContDiffBump (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] : Prop where
94:   out : Nonempty (ContDiffBumpBase E)
95: 
96: /-- In a space with `C^∞` bump functions, register some function that will be used as a basis
97: to construct bump functions of arbitrary size around any point. -/
98: def someContDiffBumpBase (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
99:     [hb : HasContDiffBump E] : ContDiffBumpBase E :=
100:   Nonempty.some hb.out
101: 
102: namespace ContDiffBump
103: 
104: theorem rOut_pos {c : E} (f : ContDiffBump c) : 0 < f.rOut :=
105:   f.rIn_pos.trans f.rIn_lt_rOut
106: 
107: theorem one_lt_rOut_div_rIn {c : E} (f : ContDiffBump c) : 1 < f.rOut / f.rIn := by
108:   rw [one_lt_div f.rIn_pos]
109:   exact f.rIn_lt_rOut
110: 
111: instance (c : E) : Inhabited (ContDiffBump c) :=
112:   ⟨⟨1, 2, zero_lt_one, one_lt_two⟩⟩
113: 
114: variable [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
115:   [HasContDiffBump E] {c : E} (f : ContDiffBump c) {x : E} {n : ℕ∞}
116: 
117: /-- The function defined by `f : ContDiffBump c`. Use automatic coercion to
118: function instead. -/
119: @[coe] def toFun {c : E} (f : ContDiffBump c) : E → ℝ :=
120:   (someContDiffBumpBase E).toFun (f.rOut / f.rIn) ∘ fun x ↦ (f.rIn⁻¹ • (x - c))
121: 
122: instance : CoeFun (ContDiffBump c) fun _ => E → ℝ :=
123:   ⟨toFun⟩
124: 
125: protected theorem apply (x : E) :
126:     f x = (someContDiffBumpBase E).toFun (f.rOut / f.rIn) (f.rIn⁻¹ • (x - c)) :=
127:   rfl
128: 
129: protected theorem sub (x : E) : f (c - x) = f (c + x) := by
130:   simp [f.apply, ContDiffBumpBase.symmetric]
131: 
132: protected theorem neg (f : ContDiffBump (0 : E)) (x : E) : f (-x) = f x := by
133:   simp_rw [← zero_sub, f.sub, zero_add]
134: 
135: open Metric
136: 
137: theorem one_of_mem_closedBall (hx : x ∈ closedBall c f.rIn) : f x = 1 := by
138:   apply ContDiffBumpBase.eq_one _ _ f.one_lt_rOut_div_rIn
139:   simpa only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_of_nonneg f.rIn_pos.le, ← div_eq_inv_mul,
140:     div_le_one f.rIn_pos] using mem_closedBall_iff_norm.1 hx
141: 
142: theorem nonneg : 0 ≤ f x :=
143:   (ContDiffBumpBase.mem_Icc (someContDiffBumpBase E) _ _).1
144: 
145: /-- A version of `ContDiffBump.nonneg` with `x` explicit -/
146: theorem nonneg' (x : E) : 0 ≤ f x := f.nonneg
147: 
148: theorem le_one : f x ≤ 1 :=
149:   (ContDiffBumpBase.mem_Icc (someContDiffBumpBase E) _ _).2
150: 
151: theorem support_eq : Function.support f = Metric.ball c f.rOut := by
152:   simp only [toFun, support_comp_eq_preimage, ContDiffBumpBase.support _ _ f.one_lt_rOut_div_rIn]
153:   ext x
154:   simp only [mem_ball_iff_norm, sub_zero, norm_smul, mem_preimage, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv,

156: 
157: theorem tsupport_eq : tsupport f = closedBall c f.rOut := by
158:   simp_rw [tsupport, f.support_eq, closure_ball _ f.rOut_pos.ne']
159:

161:   f.nonneg.lt_of_ne' <| by rwa [← support_eq, mem_support] at hx
162: 
163: theorem zero_of_le_dist (hx : f.rOut ≤ dist x c) : f x = 0 := by
164:   rwa [← notMem_support, support_eq, mem_ball, not_lt]
165: 
166: protected theorem hasCompactSupport [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] : HasCompactSupport f := by
167:   simp_rw [HasCompactSupport, f.tsupport_eq, isCompact_closedBall]
168:

170:   mem_of_superset (closedBall_mem_nhds_of_mem h) fun _ ↦ f.one_of_mem_closedBall
171: 
172: theorem eventuallyEq_one : f =ᶠ[𝓝 c] 1 :=
173:   f.eventuallyEq_one_of_mem_ball (mem_ball_self f.rIn_pos)
